views.breadcrumb: CMMS Lab / Work Queue / Annual Work Order

steps.action: Open the screen help modal, review the queue purpose, available actions and meeting/decision rationale, then close it without losing queue state.
Search or filter the annual preventive view, inspect a row and open an annual preventive order.
Open the screen help modal, review how planned actions and actual executions are represented and the supporting decisions, then close it.
Inspect plan provenance, cycle, planned actions and inline execution evidence for a selected action.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough participant; named users have no inferred business role or permission.
requirements.goal: Find the annual preventive work that the first DVP slice can explain.
requirements.information: Annual preventive order identity, asset/activity, explicit cycle label, action counts, next scheduled date and displayed state.
requirements.decision: Choose an annual preventive order for inspection.
requirements.action: Search/filter/sort/page the annual PM view and open a matching annual order.
requirements.validation: Only PREVENTIVE_ANNUAL rows are shown; nonannual orders are not routed into Annual Order Detail.
requirements.result: A selected annual order opens its matching detail.
requirements.feedback: Selection and queue context remain visible in the detail breadcrumb and return path.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough participant; no plan approval authority inferred.
requirements.goal: Understand the approved-plan source represented by the synthetic annual order.
requirements.information: Asset, plan/version, activity and explicit CycleKey/display label.
requirements.decision: Recognize which synthetic plan and cycle the order represents.
requirements.action: Inspect the order context and plan provenance.
requirements.validation: All values are labelled synthetic/demo; no unapproved example is presented as a real corporate plan.
requirements.result: The order is traceable to its synthetic plan/version and cycle.
requirements.feedback: Plan identity, activity, status and cycle are shown separately.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough participant; no execution authority inferred.
requirements.goal: Distinguish planned preventive actions from work actually performed.
requirements.information: Each planned-action date/state and linked ExecutionRecord with actual dates/result when available.
requirements.decision: Identify completed, scheduled and still-planned actions.
requirements.action: Select an action and review its execution evidence inline when present.
requirements.validation: DueAt, ScheduledAt and actual dates remain distinct; missing actuals/results are not fabricated.
requirements.result: The user understands which action is executed and what result was recorded.
requirements.feedback: Execution details remain in the order view and do not imply a separate route.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough participant; no disposition authority inferred.
requirements.goal: Recognize which planned actions remain pending at cycle end.
requirements.information: Completed and pending action states and the absence of a selected disposition.
requirements.decision: Understand the pending action is unresolved.
requirements.action: Review the pending action without changing its state.
requirements.validation: The demo does not close, carry forward, replace or cancel the pending action.
requirements.result: Pending remains explicit and no operational policy is inferred.

requirements.goal: Explore the synthetic annual queue without losing their place.
requirements.trigger: Search/filter a queue and open a row.
requirements.information: Current project, filters, sort, page and selected order.
requirements.decision: Return to the same queue result after inspection.
requirements.validation: Project, filters, sort, page and selection are restored; no backend write occurs.
requirements.result: The read-only walkthrough continues from the same context.
requirements.feedback: Queue returns with the same view state.

requirements.actor: Any user of the Work Queue screen.
requirements.goal: Understand how the annual PM queue works and why its boundaries and interactions were chosen.
requirements.trigger: Select the visible How it works action in Work Queue.
requirements.information: Screen purpose; meaning and synthetic origin of queue data; available and excluded actions; decision summaries with date, source and authority status.
requirements.decision: Choose the supported queue interaction with a clear understanding of its rationale and limits.
requirements.action: Open/read/close the modal; use any listed search/filter/sort/page/open-order interaction only when implemented.
requirements.validation: The modal distinguishes the 21-Aug AS-IS flow, 25-Sep meeting decisions, and later DEC-025/proposal baseline; it does not attribute annual grouping to the earlier meeting or present pending TR policy as ratified.
requirements.result: The user understands why the queue is annual-only, synthetic, and read-only.
requirements.feedback: Modal opens and closes without changing queue data or context.

requirements.actor: Any user of the Annual Order Detail screen.
requirements.goal: Understand how to read the annual order, planned actions and actual execution evidence, and why they are separated.
requirements.trigger: Select the visible How it works action in Annual Order Detail.
requirements.information: Screen purpose; meanings of plan/cycle/action/ExecutionRecord; available and excluded actions; decision summaries with date, source and authority status.
requirements.decision: Interpret completed, scheduled, planned and with-deviation states without assuming unapproved authority or policy.
requirements.action: Open/read/close the modal; inspect an action and its inline execution evidence when present.
requirements.validation: The modal traces separate planned and actual data to the 25-Sep meeting and DEC-025/proposal baseline; it identifies the latter as a post-meeting candidate awaiting TR ratification.
requirements.result: The user understands the detail interaction and does not confuse a planned action with an execution.
requirements.feedback: Modal opens and closes without changing the selected action or queue return context.
